Frontend Design

Anthropic verified

Frontend design skill for UI/UX implementation

Superpowers

Anthropic verified

Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques

Code Review

Anthropic verified

Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring

Context7

Anthropic verified

Upstash Context7 MCP server for up-to-date documentation lookup. Connects to Context7's hosted remote MCP server (https://mcp.context7.com/mcp) — no local Node.js or npx required — to pull version-specific documentation and code examples directly from source repositories into your LLM context. Authenticate with Context7 when prompted.

Code Simplifier

Anthropic verified

Agent that simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving functionality

Playwright

Anthropic verified

Browser automation and end-to-end testing MCP server by Microsoft. Enables Claude to interact with web pages, take screenshots, fill forms, click elements, and perform automated browser testing workflows.

GitHub

Anthropic verified

Official GitHub MCP server for repository management. Create issues, manage pull requests, review code, search repositories, and interact with GitHub's full API directly from Claude Code.

CLAUDE.md Management

Anthropic verified

Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

Feature Dev

Anthropic verified

Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

Security Guidance

Anthropic verified

Security review for Claude-generated code. Pattern-based warnings on edits, LLM-powered diff review on Stop, and an agentic commit reviewer that catches injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, and 25+ other vulnerability classes.

Vercel

Anthropic verified

Build and deploy web apps and agents

TypeScript LSP

Anthropic verified

TypeScript/JavaScript language server for enhanced code intelligence

Ralph Loop

Anthropic verified

Continuous self-referential AI loops for interactive iterative development, implementing the Ralph Wiggum technique. Run Claude in a while-true loop with the same prompt until task completion.

Claude Code Setup

Anthropic verified

Analyze codebases and recommend tailored Claude Code automations such as hooks, skills, MCP servers, and subagents.

Commit Commands

Anthropic verified

Streamline your git workflow with simple commands for committing, pushing, and creating pull requests

Figma

Figma integration: access design files, extract components, read tokens, translate to code. Bridge design-development gap.

Supabase

Anthropic verified

Official Supabase plugin for Claude Code with bundled Supabase skills and MCP access for project management, database work, auth, storage, and Postgres best practices.

PR Review Toolkit

Anthropic verified

Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification

Pyright LSP

Anthropic verified

Python language server (Pyright) for type checking and code intelligence

Chrome DevTools

Control and inspect a live Chrome browser from your coding agent. Record performance traces, analyze network requests...

Telegram

Anthropic verified

Telegram channel for Claude Code — messaging bridge with built-in access control. Manage pairing, allowlists, and policy via /telegram:access.

Atlassian MCP

Anthropic verified

Connect to Atlassian products including Jira and Confluence. Search and create issues, access documentation, manage sprints, and integrate your development workflow with Atlassian's collaboration tools.

Slack

Anthropic verified

Slack AI tools for users and developers: interact with your workspace via the Slack MCP server and use skills to develop Slack apps.

Serena

Anthropic verified

Semantic code analysis MCP server providing intelligent code understanding, refactoring suggestions, and codebase navigation through language server protocol integration.
